name: identity
expect: Output equals input (max difference <= 1 per channel).

name: shadows-only
expect: Dark regions clearly brighter, bright regions nearly unchanged, no channel decreases.

name: highlights-only
expect: Bright regions clearly darker, dark regions nearly unchanged, no channel increases.

name: combined
expect: Compressed tonal range: shadows lifted, highlights slightly reduced, midtones nearly unchanged.

name: zero-radius
expect: Unblurred mask: adjustment follows pixel luminance exactly, may look slightly flat but must not crash or show artifacts.

name: large-radius
expect: Very soft mask transitions, no blocky steps or banding; mild halos near strong edges are acceptable but should be wide and faint.
